text: Aircraft Design is one of the core specialties in the aerospace field, focusing on the overall design, performance optimization, structural safety, and engineering implementation of various aircraft (such as fixed-wing aircraft, helicopters, unmanned aerial vehicles, etc.). This discipline is based on aerodynamics, structural mechanics, and control engineering, and combines engineering practice and innovation. The aim is to develop safe, efficient, cost-effective aircraft that meet specific mission requirements, ranging from civilian passenger planes, fighter jets to cargo drones and special aircraft, covering the core aspects of the aerospace industry.
